summary.text: James W. "Jim" Masland, a Democrat from Thetford, has represented Windsor-Orange-2 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 1999.
He sits on the House Committee on Ways and Means and the Board of Trustees of the Vermont State Colleges Corporation.

paragraphs.text: Masland has lived in Thetford since 1979 and works as a work-based learning consultant and builder, according to his House biography.
He attended Williston Academy and earned a BA from Stanford University and an M.S. from the Stanford School of Engineering.
He served on the Thetford selectboard from 1987 to 2000 and was president of the Vermont League of Cities and Towns in 1992-93.
He was also a VISTA volunteer in 1973-74 and serves on the ECFiber Executive Committee.
He is married to Suzanne, and they have five daughters and two sons.
